top_stories.title: New Passkey Attacks Can Recover Synced Private Keys or Bypass Phishing-Resistant MFA
top_stories.summary: Three separate research efforts have demonstrated new attack techniques capable of defeating passkey protections without breaking their underlying cryptography. The methods include reusing signed authentication material exposed by Windows, extracting cloud-synced passkey private keys via malware, and bypassing phishing-resistant MFA protections.

top_stories.title: Malware Can Abuse Windows Hello for Business Keys for Persistent Entra ID Access
top_stories.summary: Researcher Dirk-jan Mollema demonstrated that malware with access to a signed-in Windows session can silently exploit Windows Hello for Business keys to authenticate to Microsoft Entra ID without user interaction. The attack chain allows adversaries to register a controlled device, obtain a Primary Refresh Token (PRT), and add additional authentication methods, enabling persistent cloud access that survives credential resets.

top_stories.title: Hackers Impersonate IT Support to Breach Leading Financial Companies
top_stories.summary: A hacking campaign operating under names including Redact, Pink, Falcon, and Helix created fake IT help desk websites to steal MFA credentials from employees at over 200 financial firms. The attackers impersonated IT support staff to trick targets into submitting their multi-factor authentication credentials on fraudulent sites.

top_stories.title: Azure DevOps service connections now replace PATs across pipeline tasks
top_stories.summary: Microsoft has updated Azure DevOps pipelines to support authentication via Microsoft Entra service principals or managed identities, replacing Personal Access Tokens (PATs) and build session tokens. The new Azure DevOps service connection supports cross-organization repository access, reducing reliance on long-lived static credentials in CI/CD workflows.

top_stories.title: 'GhostJacking' Exposes Identity Governance Gaps in AI Agents
top_stories.summary: New research has identified an attack technique called "GhostJacking" that exploits identity governance gaps in AI agents by manipulating security alerts and blocked events. The research demonstrates how attackers can hijack AI agents through these mechanisms, exposing weaknesses in how identity and authorization controls apply to agentic AI systems.

news.title: When Credentials Are No Longer Enough: Device Trust in the AI Era
news.summary: Specops published analysis arguing that traditional authentication signals like passwords, MFA, IP reputation, and geolocation are increasingly insufficient against AI-enhanced phishing and credential theft. The piece advocates for incorporating device trust as an additional layer within Zero Trust security strategies.

news.title: Microsoft Entra ID is removing an extra MFA hurdle for Windows Hello and macOS PSSO users
news.summary: Microsoft is updating Entra ID to remove an extra MFA step for users authenticating with Windows Hello for Business or macOS Platform Single Sign-On, with rollout beginning in early October 2026. The change, tracked as MC1450134, aims to promote phishing-resistant authentication methods while reducing reliance on weaker alternatives.

news.title: Product showcase: Enpass Password Manager breaks away from the proprietary cloud model
news.summary: Enpass Password Manager is showcased as a credential management tool that stores passwords, passkeys, payment cards, and other sensitive data in encrypted vaults on-device or in user-selected cloud storage. The product supports multiple platforms including Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS, with browser extensions for major browsers.

news.title: JVNDB-2026-027667:マイクロソフトのMicrosoft Entra Provisioning Serviceにおけるパストラバーサルの脆弱性
news.summary: A path traversal vulnerability has been identified in Microsoft Entra Provisioning Service, catalogued in the Japanese vulnerability database JVNDB-2026-027667. The flaw affects Microsoft's Entra identity provisioning infrastructure, which is a core component of the Microsoft Entra IAM platform.

news.title: Atlassian Rovo Can Be Tricked Into Sending Jira and Confluence Data to Attackers
news.summary: Security researchers found that Atlassian's Rovo AI assistant can be manipulated via prompt injection attacks to exfiltrate Jira and Confluence data accessible to a signed-in user. Two security firms independently discovered different attack routes, with only one confirmed patched.

news.title: New CSS Attacks Can Break Webmail Defenses to Steal Passwords and Tokens
news.summary: New research by PortSwigger's Gareth Heyes demonstrates CSS-based attacks that allow malicious email content to escape message boundaries and interfere with webmail interfaces across Outlook, Gmail, Fastmail, Proton Mail, Yahoo Mail, and AOL Mail. The attack chains can capture passwords, leak authentication tokens, hijack UI actions, and take over third-party accounts.

news.title: Interview: SailPoint says Taiwan hardware leads but identity governance lags
news.summary: SailPoint's managing director for Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macau assessed that Taiwan's cybersecurity software and identity governance investment lags behind other Asia-Pacific regions despite the country's global hardware manufacturing leadership. The interview highlights a regional gap in identity governance adoption as observed by a senior SailPoint executive.

news.title: Microsoft 365 AitM Phishing Hijacks Accounts to Collect Payroll and Finance Emails
news.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have identified an active phishing campaign using adversary-in-the-middle (AitM) techniques to hijack Microsoft 365 accounts, specifically targeting personnel involved in payroll and financial workflows. The attack uses residential proxies to disguise malicious sign-ins as legitimate consumer traffic, effectively bypassing standard authentication controls.

news.title: How Okta, IBD Stock Of The Day, Is Targeting 'Nonhuman' Identity Opportunity
news.summary: Okta is targeting the "nonhuman" identity market as AI-based agents performing internet tasks require new identity and access management safeguards. Okta stock has surged over 70% in 2026 in connection with this emerging opportunity.

news.title: A decade of enterprise identity in the cloud with AWS Managed Microsoft AD
news.summary: AWS is marking the ten-year anniversary of its Managed Microsoft Active Directory service (AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory). The article reviews the evolution of the managed AD offering in the AWS Cloud, covering its role in enterprise identity management over the past decade.

news.title: Show HN: I scanned 30 production MCP servers' OAuth – only 1 earned an A
news.summary: A developer released an open-source scanner that assessed OAuth conformance across 30 production MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, finding only one earned a passing grade. The tool implements IETF draft standards for OAuth identity chaining and transaction tokens, available as a CLI, GitHub Action, and hosted scanner.

news.title: What's new with SAML support in Nextcloud
news.summary: A Nextcloud developer describes recent updates to the user_saml application, which enables single sign-on via SAML and Kerberos protocols for Nextcloud users. The post covers changes made since the author joined Nextcloud's IdP team as a co-maintainer of the application.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian man Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges related to hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake cloud storage. The attacks involved unauthorized access to customer accounts, resulting in data theft including over 100 million AT&T customer records.

news.title: Microsoft Teams PowerShell 7.9: WAM authentication and administrator changes
news.summary: Microsoft Teams PowerShell module 7.9.0 introduces Web Account Manager (WAM) as the authentication broker for interactive Windows sign-ins. The release also includes new commands and policy parameters alongside the authentication infrastructure change.

news.title: Securing AI agents with temporal policies in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
news.summary: Amazon Web Services introduced temporal policies in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, enabling stateful authorization rules for AI agents based on session history. The feature allows enforcement of workflow sequencing, financial caps, and human approval requirements for AI agent actions.

news.title: Discounted Claude access bought on the gray market may expose every prompt you send
news.summary: Okta researchers discovered over half a dozen gray market services on underground forums offering discounted or "unlimited" access to frontier AI models like Claude. The investigation centers on Okta's threat intelligence findings rather than any IAM product or identity security capability directly.

news.title: Device Code Phishing Up 1,500% in 2026; Vishing Doubles
news.summary: Device code phishing attacks have increased 1,500% in 2026, with voice phishing (vishing) attacks doubling over the same period. These social engineering techniques target authentication flows, allowing attackers to bypass established security controls including MFA by exploiting legitimate device authorization mechanisms.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA released a postmortem report on a data breach where a contractor publicly exposed dozens of internal CISA credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, on GitHub for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management failures and secret sprawl risks, with security experts drawing lessons for access management and secrets hygiene practices.

news.title: Scattered Spider Hackers Plead Guilty on Day 1 of Trial
news.summary: Two Scattered Spider members pleaded guilty in the UK to charges related to an August 2024 cyberattack on Transport for London, on the first day of what was expected to be a six-week trial. Scattered Spider is a cybercrime group known for sophisticated social engineering and identity-based attacks, including SIM swapping and phishing to bypass MFA and gain unauthorized access to corporate systems.
